response.overview: Youth – Ketama Vision is a 2011 DVD + CD release (catalog ALG067) on Algorythmik Records / Ketama Records, recorded in Ketama, Moscow, and pressed in Russia. This is a continuous DJ mix by Youth — described as blending tech house, dub, ambient, tribal house, and downtempo — running about 66:45, spanning 15–16 tracks by artists including Cult of Youth, Dub Trees, Suns of Arqa, Transmission, Nada, and The Kumba Mela Experiment. Tracks are licensed from Liquid Sound Design, with one licensed from Malicious Damage. The accompanying video was created by Mike Coles (also credited for the sleeve design) — notably the same artist behind The Orb's C Batter C DVD.
response.title: Youth: Ketama Vision
